Even though there isn't enough snow for skiing, we are open today from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.

Stop by to:

Do some Christmas shopping.

Organize your locker

Pick up your season pass.

Drop off your equipment for a tune.

Enjoy a warm bowl of soup, the soup of the day is Beef Barley.

Watch Michigan vs. Ohio State in Nub's Pub at noon 🏈.

Think cold and snow! ❄️
